# phone-config-nginx

## Files

- xpbx1.nix
- default.nix

## File Summaries

### xpbx1.nix
HTTPS provisioning server config for xpbx1; serves phone configs by MAC address via DHCP option 66.

### default.nix
Phone config provisioning module; serves configs over HTTPS (nginx) and TFTP. Host-specific configs live in <hostname>.nix
